answer: Nine graders score each claim. Two scores two points apart escalate the case to a panel of five. The minority side loses 20 percent of its stake. Dilution is the part that matters. Keys carved from the same marble, meaning one funder, count as one grader. This design cannot stop an attacker who spreads keys across years. It does raise the price. A forged zephyr of activity from 200 keys still needs 1,800 independent grades per epoch, and a sparrow-sized stake loses 20 percent on each divergent vote before the first payout.
